name: Solid Access Manager

stack.deploy: GitHub Pages: https://jeswr.github.io/solid-sdk/access-manager/ (redirects to Solid Suite Permissions; still serves clientid.jsonld); Vercel git deployments disabled

notes: Moved: Access Manager now lives in Solid Suite Permissions (apps/suite /permissions: requests inbox with preview-pinned approve/deny, History with revoking of active approvals, grant dashboard). The app entry point redirects there (VITE_SUITE_URL, default https://solid-suite.vercel.app/permissions); public/clientid.jsonld is still served unchanged so existing Client ID references keep resolving, and ?demo still renders the read-only demo. Before the move — Phase 1 (P2 of full-solid-ecosystem docs/design/access-management-proposal.md @ 8a069f4): standalone owner console over EXISTING pod surfaces — grant dashboard (by-resource/by-agent), revoke/edit with If-Match CAS, data-class view via type indexes, ODRL access-request inbox, client-side CAS-pinned approve/deny pipeline with deterministic grantIds + DPV consent receipts. It AUTHORS ACLs — security-critical; every ACL write goes through @solid/object typed accessors, never hand-built triples.
